```{python}
#| label: fig-sim-tran-vs-pss
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Transient response of a resonator with $Q = 50$ that is driven at its resonance frequency from $t = 0$. A transient analysis has to integrate about 110 periods until the amplitude is within 0.1 % of its final value; a PSS analysis solves for the single steady-state period (red) directly; for this linear tank, a single shooting iteration over one period suffices."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- model ----------
# Parallel RLC tank driven by a sinusoidal current at its resonance frequency,
# switched on at t = 0. For high Q the response is a sinusoid at f0 whose
# envelope rises with the time constant tau = 2Q/omega0, i.e., tau/T0 = Q/pi.
Q = 50
tau = Q / np.pi                # time constant in periods of the drive
eps = 1e-3                     # settling accuracy (0.1 %)
n_settle = tau * np.log(1 / eps)

n_per = 130                    # number of simulated periods
t = np.linspace(0, n_per, n_per * 200 + 1)   # time in periods
env = 1 - np.exp(-t / tau)
v = env * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t)

# the periodic steady state: one period, x(T) = x(0)
t_pss = np.linspace(0, 1, 201)
v_pss = np.sin(2 * np.pi * t_pss)

# ---------- plot ----------
fig, (ax, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.6), sharey=True,
                              gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [3, 1]})

ax.plot(t, v, color='tab:blue', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.8, label='transient (tran)')
ax.plot(t, env, 'k--', linewidth=1.2, label=r'envelope $1 - e^{-t/\tau}$')

ax.axvline(n_settle, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=1)
ax.annotate('', xy=(n_settle, -1.25), xytext=(0, -1.25),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='gray', lw=1.2))
ax.text(n_settle / 2, -1.2, f'settling to 0.1 %: {n_settle:.0f} periods',
        ha='center', va='bottom', color='gray')

ax.set_title('tran: integrate until settled', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel(r'Time $t / T_0$')
ax.set_ylabel('Tank voltage (normalized)')
ax.set_xlim(0, n_per)
ax.set_ylim(-1.4, 1.4)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
leg = ax.legend(loc='upper center', ncol=2, fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)
for line in leg.get_lines():
    line.set_linewidth(1.5)
    line.set_alpha(1)

ax2.plot(t_pss, v_pss, color='red', linewidth=2.5)
ax2.plot([0, 1], [v_pss[0], v_pss[-1]], 'ko', markersize=5)
ax2.text(0.5, -1.2, r'$x(T_0) = x(0)$', ha='center', va='bottom')
ax2.set_title('PSS: one period', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel(r'Time $t / T_0$')
ax2.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
